incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8421 fired for metric: gpu_mem_pressure_us-west-2-pool-3 > 90% (sustained 75s). Top error: \"CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY\" from model-worker: model-6B-worker-3.

pagerduty: Alert details: service=redwood-gpu-pool-usw2, severity=critical, key=PD-8421, link=https://pagerduty.example/PD-8421. Escalation: primary -> alice_j (10m) -> ben_m (30m).

alice_j: acked PD-8421 :hand: I'm looking. seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` failures in the logs.

ben_m: pinging, grabbing logs. Can someone check if any rolling deploy happened?

carla_sre: no deploys in the last hour. metric spike shows kvcache_evictions high + per-process RSS jump. Suspect KV cache leak or large batch requests.

alice_j: `ssh worker-3` now. Running `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv -i 0`. Output:
```
# GPU 0, memory.used [MiB] = 31798, memory.total [MiB] = 32768
```
Looks near full. `ps aux | grep model-server` shows one process with huge RSS ~30GiB.

ben_m: grabbing docker stats: `docker stats --no-stream`. Container model-server-6b on node-3 shows ~99% GPU mem.

david_prod: alert from routing: ~1200 requests in last 5m got 503s from pool-3. Customer-facing tag: some users in APIGW saw timeouts. Not wide but visible.

sre-rotation: can we gracefully drain pool-3 and route new traffic to pool-4 (us-west-2) and eu-west-1 fallback?

alice_j: starting drain: `routeset update pool-3 --drain=true --weight=0.0 --reason \"oom investigation\"` (will take ~15s to propagate).

carla_sre: quick mitigation idea: evict largest KV entries and restart model process to reclaim memory. If it's KV leak, restart will help quickly. Any live traffic pinned to this worker?

ben_m: checking sticky sessions: no sticky assignments, load balancer will retry. good to restart.

alice_j: performing `kubectl delete pod model-6b-worker-3 -n infra-serving --grace-period=30`. Pod is terminating, new pod scheduled on same node? I set `nodeSelector: avoid-hot-node=1` to prefer cooler node.
text_2:
david_prod: customer impact: approximate failed requests = 1.2k over last 5m, error rate spike from 0.2% -> 5.1% for model-6B. No major SLAs breached yet but close for a few high-traffic tenants. Notifying CS.

cs-oncall: notified customers with known high-volume contracts; telling them: small degraded service, working on mitigation.

ben_m: after restart, new pod came up but it's still using a lot of GPU mem (18GiB) — maybe checkpoint warmup. Watching model logs for repeated OOMs.

carla_sre: ran `grep -n "kvcache.*insert" /var/log/model-server.log | tail -n 50` — seeing repeated increases in kvcache size without eviction. maybe eviction policy misbehaving under recent config.

alice_j: temporarily lowered kvcache max entries: `KVCACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=100000 -> 40000` and redeployed config. Monitoring.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-8421 acknowledged by alice_j. Escalation suppressed.

ben_m: after config change, GPU mem trending down on new pod: 18GiB -> 12GiB over 2m. error rate falling.

carla_sre: rolling restart for the rest of pool-3 scheduled with 30s stagger to avoid cold-start thundering herd.

alice_j: marking pool drain complete; traffic shifted off pool-3 to pool-4. Confirming 503s drop.

ben_m: metrics: requests failed in last 10m = 1.6k, but in last 2m = 120. Error rate now 0.6%. Still monitoring.

cs-oncall: updating customer notice: issue mitigated; some retries may have affected a subset of requests between 03:22 - 03:32 UTC.

sre-rotation: any need to escalate to oncall infra-cpu/gpu teams?

carla_sre: not for now; root cause likely KV cache growth after recent config change to `prefetch_batch=32` done earlier today — file ticket to revert or tune.

alice_j: creating incident summary for handoff: PD-8421, start=1718801234, mitigated=1718801800. Actions: drained pool-3, restarted model server, reduced KVCACHE_MAX_ENTRIES, scheduled rolling restarts for pool. Customer impact: ~1.6k failed/retied requests, minor for most customers, CS notified. Next steps: postmortem, revert prefetch batch -> 16 or implement dynamic eviction.

ben_m: adding link to temporary dashboard snapshot: https://dashboards.redwood/shot/PD-8421-snapshot

alice_j: handing off to `sre-rotation` for follow-up and postmortem. If anyone sees recurrence, page me.

incident-bot: PD-8421 resolved by alice_j at 1718801920. Incident closed. :white_check_mark: 

carla_sre: filing postmortem ticket now and assigning owners: kvcache-team + runtime-ops.

alice_j: thanks everyone. follow-up items: 1) add eviction metrics to alerting, 2) add guardrail on prefetch_batch rollout, 3) investigate kvcache leak.

ben_m: :thumbsup:
